26 days on testing. A total of 114,2 MMkr were spent on the well, 82,7 MMkr on the drilling and 31,5 MMkr on the testing. After finished testing, the well was plugged and abandoned and the Dyvi Delta left location at 15:00 hours the 23th October to drill 34/10-22.
rillpipe and the shoe set at 4000 m, the top of the liner at 3033 m. The liner was successfully cemented. 2 drill stem tests were performed before the well was plugged and abandoned.
